description: Defines a template class 'pool_allocator' for custom memory allocation using a global pool allocator, along with functions to manage the global allocator. It facilitates STL container memory management with pooled allocation.

classes.name: pool_allocator
classes.description: A template class providing a custom allocator that uses a global pool allocator for memory management in STL containers.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for n elements using the global pool allocator.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T at the given memory location.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys an object of type T at the given memory location.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements that can be allocated.

methods.name: getAllocator
methods.description: Returns a reference to the global pool allocator.
